data.change_summary: Addressed both pending amendments. I updated the too-old save-file remediation path so `SchemaVersionTooOld` now tells users to re-create the save with a newer version of the application, and I extended `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` to assert that guidance is present. I also made `crates/tank_core/tests/shrimp_population.rs::hatch_produces_juveniles` deterministic by exercising the ideal direct hatch path with hatch inputs pinned to 1.0 and asserting the exact 25-juvenile outcome instead of relying on the RNG-sensitive `Engine::step_hours(24)` path.
outstanding_risks: Known unrelated architectural issue carried forward from prior review: `Engine::step_hours` still calls `enforce_invariants(&mut self.state)` before returning some invariant errors, so a rejected step can still mutate live state.

steps.description: Inspected the pending amendments against the current `SimError` save-version messages and the shrimp hatch test to confirm the remaining gaps were actionable remediation text and RNG-dependent hatch coverage.
Updated the old-save error/test coverage and rewrote `hatch_produces_juveniles` to use a deterministic ideal-hatch setup with exact juvenile-count assertions.
Ran focused validation for save/load behavior, shrimp population tests, clippy, and formatting on the touched files.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed: 18 tests passed, including `very_old_schema_version_produces_clear_error` with the new remediation-message assertion.
`cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population` passed: 10 tests passed, including the now-deterministic `hatch_produces_juveniles` case.
`cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.
